note: Brief 013 B (Keel, 2026-10-16): the security level the Handover runs at, until the district plan (plan.areas[*].securityBase, Datum) and mission.json (securityBonus, Waymark) carry it. The world's takedown facts (stashes, call boxes, robot docks, police posts) came here first from Vantage's survey; since Splice's export (sim/data/handover.takedown.json, tools/sim/takedown.ts) carries them, they are read from there and this file holds the level only.

security.src: briefs/013/motive-takedowns.md §5.3 (Sky 2026-10-16 merged call 3): the civic district's base level is 2 (watchful), the Handover's own bonus 0, no open cases. Replaced by plan.areas[*].securityBase (Datum) and mission.json securityBonus (Waymark).

district.src: Brief 014 (Keel, 2026-10-16): Standing is per district (§04; rulebook standing). The Handover plays in one district, the plan's own (contracts/world/harbour-district.plan.json id). Replaced by the plan and the campaign layer when they carry it.
